intro_sketch: Drawing has always been one of those fine arts that fascinates me and that I want to practise myself. It is not the final product that captures my attention, but the process of creating it: seeing the object of a drawing as a combination of form, shape, line and flow, light and shade. The ability to just sit down quietly and focus on the making and the practising, using eye-hand coordination, making sure you stroke it right, is so absorbing that you get lost in it.
intro_poetry: Poetry, to me, is the expression of one's experience and state of emotion in a structured way. Searching for the words to describe what I feel at that moment, then building the verse so that it rhymes in a poetic form of choice, is truly satisfying. It is like solving a puzzle. In fact, it is like engineering. Unfortunately, my poems are written in my language, Khmer, because it is the language that comes most naturally to me. In fact, it seems the language itself was made for poetry, only that nobody notices.
